title: Accessibility rules
description: Static accessibility rules for JSX and templates: names, labels, roles, keyboard access and ARIA validity.

rules.title: img without alt
rules.message: An img has no alt attribute.
rules.fix: Add a meaningful alt, or alt="" for purely decorative images.
rules.rationale: Screen readers announce the file name when alt is missing.

rules.title: Click handler on a non-interactive element without role, tabIndex and key handler
rules.message: A click handler sits on an element that is not keyboard accessible.
rules.fix: Use a button or link, or add role, tabIndex and a key handler.
rules.rationale: A div with onClick is invisible to keyboards and assistive technology.

rules.title: button without explicit type
rules.message: A button has no explicit type and submits forms by default.
rules.rationale: The default type is submit, which causes accidental form submissions.

rules.title: Form control without an associated label
rules.message: A form control has no accessible label.
rules.fix: Wrap it in a label, use label htmlFor with the control id, or add aria-label.
rules.rationale: Unlabelled controls cannot be named by assistive technology.

rules.title: Positive tabIndex
rules.message: A positive tabIndex overrides the natural focus order.
rules.fix: Use tabIndex 0 or -1 and fix the DOM order instead.
rules.rationale: Positive values create a separate, fragile tab sequence.

rules.title: aria-hidden on a focusable element
rules.message: A focusable element is hidden from assistive technology.
rules.fix: Remove aria-hidden or make the element non-focusable.
rules.rationale: Keyboard focus lands on something screen readers cannot announce.

rules.title: Anchor without href used as a button
rules.message: An anchor without href is used as a button.
rules.fix: Use a button for actions and an anchor with href for navigation.
rules.rationale: An anchor without href is not focusable or announced as a link.

rules.title: Icon-only button or link without accessible name
rules.message: A button or link has no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.
rules.fix: Add visible text or an aria-label that names the action.
rules.rationale: Icon-only controls are announced as just "button" without a name.

rules.title: Custom widget role needs keyboard behaviour review
rules.message: A custom widget role needs the keyboard behaviour of its ARIA pattern.
rules.fix: Implement the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern or use a native element.
rules.rationale: Roles promise behaviour; without it the widget misleads assistive technology.

rules.title: placeholder used without a label
rules.message: A control relies on its placeholder as its only label.
rules.fix: Add a visible label or aria-label; keep the placeholder as a hint only.
rules.rationale: Placeholders disappear on input and are not reliable names.

rules.title: autoFocus used
rules.message: autoFocus moves focus without a user action.
rules.fix: Remove it unless the element is a dialog's first control.
rules.rationale: Unexpected focus moves disorient screen reader and keyboard users.

rules.title: Invalid ARIA attribute, role or missing required attribute
rules.message: An ARIA attribute or role is invalid, or a required attribute is missing.
rules.fix: Use a name from WAI-ARIA 1.2 and add the attributes the role requires.
rules.rationale: Invalid ARIA is ignored or misread by assistive technology.

rules.title: Autoplaying media without muted
rules.fix: Remove autoplay, or mute the media and offer controls.
rules.rationale: Unexpected audio interferes with screen readers and users.

rules.title: Data table without header cells or caption
rules.message: A table has neither header cells nor a caption.
rules.fix: Add th cells with scope, or a caption; use role="presentation" for layout tables.
rules.rationale: Header cells let assistive technology relate each value to its headings.
